Does the expression that selects what to invoke run before its input?
struct A { A(); }; void (*get_f())(A); void f() { get_f()(A{}); }

When the comma operator is overloaded, is the left operand sequenced before the right?
struct A { A(); }; struct C { void operator,(A); }; A make_a(); C make_c(); void f() { make_c(), make_a(); }

Is side_effect() sequenced before the argument of the call?
struct A { A(); }; void callee(A); void side_effect(); void f() { (side_effect(), callee)(A{}); }
